name: stage3c_recovery_policy_v1
purpose: Separate recovery-probability and incremental-cost prediction with an explicit online controller.

supervision.recovery_target: finite-depth Oracle correct_accept after taking an acquisition action
supervision.cost_target: Oracle leaf measured_tool_cost_s minus live state frame_tool_cost_s
supervision.online_boundary: Targets use evaluator-only GT/Oracle outcomes; online policy receives only structured state and action descriptors.

controller.memory_rule: Memory is retrieval context and cannot be accepted directly; it requires fresh localizer or geometry evidence.

training.validation: per-sequence temporal tail; DAgger states remain training-only

evaluation: Use the frozen Stage 3B Pareto Gate on complete four-sequence, causal-audited rollouts.
